entry.title: KL3M research adds a proposed provenance and rewards pilot
entry.summary: New research proposes evaluating KL3M and its separate Data Project in a bounded provenance pilot. KL3M remains a research candidate alongside the selected Nemotron 3 Ultra target.

entry.title: Hermes Agent research proposes an optional interface for Sovereign Source
entry.summary: New research proposes evaluating a self-hosted Hermes Agent interface for permission and attribution services. The proposed integration has no implementation or benchmarks.

entry.title: Documents add proposed routes for independent model development
entry.summary: A new pathway proposes independently authorized development or explicit contractual permission for ChatGPT-assisted model development. The specification adds a proposed requirement to record authorization before using externally generated material.

entry.title: Gemini research proposes permission checks for model training
entry.summary: A new report proposes excluding Gemini-generated training material from Nemotron adaptation unless a governing agreement expressly permits the workflow. It compares access routes, exceptions and commercial exposure.

entry.title: New report examines OpenAI restrictions on competing model development
entry.summary: A new research report examines OpenAI output-use restrictions and proposes permission checks for Sovereign Source model development. It distinguishes hosted customization from independently distributed models.

entry.title: Research documents assess Nemotron ancestry, evaluation methods and data suppliers
entry.summary: New research records ancestry conflicts for the proposed Nemotron 3 Ultra target and outlines performance evaluation and supplier review proposals. The performance review reports no model downloads or benchmark runs.

entry.title: Specifications select Nemotron 3 Ultra and propose commercial integrations
entry.summary: The proposed architecture selects NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra while retaining an unresolved conflict with the earlier model ancestry requirement. The specification also proposes commercial software, licensed content supply and payout candidates without establishing vendor agreements or live integrations.

entry.title: New comparison index proposes training from scratch and holding Nemotron
entry.summary: The new index proposes Ai2 or Marin training tools for a model trained from scratch on permission-reviewed material. It proposes holding the Nemotron checkpoint because its documented Qwen ancestry fails the proposed selection screen.

entry.title: Model selection proposal puts Nemotron training target on hold
entry.summary: The documents put the proposed Nemotron 3 Nano training target on hold because its official card discloses Qwen use. No replacement model has approval.

entry.title: New draft audit compares model provider terms and proposes creator reward controls
entry.summary: A new draft audit compares provider terms on ownership, training permission, attribution and compensation. It proposes separate rights records and creator reward controls.

entry.title: Specifications add proposed creator rewards, licensing and marketplace terms
entry.summary: The documents introduce SIP Creator Rewards and draft licensing and marketplace terms for agreed contribution use. The project remains at specification stage.

entry.title: Specification adds proposed Super Intellectual Property framework and voluntary syndicates
entry.summary: The revised specification proposes Super Intellectual Property to recognize works, ideas, contributions and influences through evidence and agreements. The project remains at specification stage, with no application, trained model or production payment system.

entry.title: Documents propose a research assistant pilot and contributor royalty terms
entry.summary: New documents propose a research assistant that checks source permissions, provides attribution receipts and records eligible contributor use. The project remains at specification stage; no application, trained model or production payment system exists.

entry.title: Project specification document added
entry.summary: The repository adds a project specification document. The diff contains no text to describe its proposals.
